prose: Techmeme’s excerpt of Tech Funding News reports a $30 million round for Kindo, bringing total funding to $57.6 million, alongside a company claim of roughly 800% annual revenue growth. The retrieved page contained unrelated recommendation text rather than the article. Customer adoption, revenue base and agent-management performance could not be checked.
highlights: Round is attributed to indexed reporting
Total funding is not annual revenue
Growth percentage is a company claim
Retrieved text was not the article
